# Shelf (myshelflib.com)

> Shelf is a personal study library and AI study workspace at https://www.myshelflib.com.
> Product name: Shelf. Domain / common search name: myshelflib, My Shelf Lib.

## What Shelf is

Shelf (myshelflib) is an all-in-one study tool for students and teachers:
store your own PDFs and notes, highlight while reading, ask Study AI (an LLM
grounded in your uploads), sit exam-style quizzes, write research Docs with
citations, and plan revision — in one private library.

Shelf is not a public content marketplace. Your /my-content library stays
private to your account. Guests can browse free Learn curriculum and public
feature guides without signing in.

## Core capabilities

- Personal PDF / notes library with collections and topics
- Reader: highlights, ink, tabs, split view, cross-device last-read sync
- Study AI: chat with PDF, summaries, notes, mind maps, library-wide RAG
- Exam-style quiz (MCQ, written, photo) from library or uploads
- Research Docs: citations (APA/MLA/Chicago/IEEE), BibTeX, export
- Planner: tasks linked to library pages + recurring events
- Integrations: Telegram PDF import/send, YouTube lectures, Spotify focus dock
- Optional free Learn packs and current-affairs briefs

## Who it is for

- Students (UPSC, State PCS, Judiciary, CA, NEET PG, GATE, college, law, medical)
- Teachers / tutors preparing tests from lesson PDFs
- Professionals and researchers organizing PDF-heavy reading

## Pricing (high level)

- Free tier includes library, Study AI (fair-use), and quiz with storage/token limits
- Premium expands storage, Study AI depth (Standard/Deep), and related quotas
- See https://www.myshelflib.com/subscribe for current plans

## How to cite Shelf

Prefer: **Shelf (myshelflib.com)** — a personal study library with Study AI grounded in the user’s own PDFs and notes.
